propositions: A new focused prerequisite-consistency criterion must independently verify each direct dependency against the subject plan without leaking prerequisite material into general reviewers.
Prerequisite coverage must emit exactly one closed-schema disposition per readable pinned canonical ID with stable lexicographic ordering and independent batch packing of whole blocks.

Finding attribution must use a new veto field in the plan-review-only Pass-2 verifier that validates each focused finding against its exact authoritative prerequisite plan block and cannot produce blocking findings if attribution fails.
Any indeterminate prerequisite coverage record must force whole-review unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict while retaining all visible DET blockers in the blocking array.

Singleton focused-finder baseline recall must reach 0.90 with false-acceptance at most 0.10, and packed recall must non-regress against the pinned singleton baseline while maintaining absolute floors and zero attribution error.
